text.tspan: Number of people living in extreme poverty by region1820 to 2018
Extreme poverty is defined as living below the International Poverty Line of $1.90 per day. Data after 1981
relates to household income or expenditure surveys collated by the World Bank; before 1981 it is based on
historical reconstructions of GDP per capita and inequality data.
Note: Data is measured in international-$ at 2011 prices to account for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
